flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds give the Democrats the edge for Senate control, and that edge widened slightly today. In [[Maine]], the Democrat Troy Jackson lost a sizable amount of ground against Susan Collins, though the market still sees it as a predicted flip. In [[Iowa]], the Democrat Josh Turek gained moderately, also a predicted flip, while in [[Texas]] the Democrat James Talarico saw a moderate drop in chances against Ken Paxton, another predicted flip.
summaries.governor: In [[Kansas]], Ty Masterson, the Republican, saw a sizable drop in chances, and the market lists it as a predicted flip. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford gained ground by a sizable margin, also a predicted flip. The Republican Phil Scott slipped by a sizable amount in [[Vermont]].
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats still favoured to take the House, though their chances slipped slightly today. In [[VA-01 (Williamsburg & Poquoson)]], the Democrat Shannon Taylor's chances rose sharply, and the market lists it as a predicted flip, while in [[NJ-02 (Vineland & Atlantic City)]] the Republican Jeff Van Drew's chances fell sharply. The projected seat count moved to 241-194, up from 240-195, with Democrats gaining control, and [[VA-05 (Lynchburg & Charlottesville)]] is a newly predicted flip.
